title: Zeus Purify Bristle Cleaners
description:
A 20 pack of ZEUS Bristle Pipe Cleaners that can be used to clean vaporizer parts and accessories. These pipe cleaners are recommended to be used in conjunction with the ZEUS Purify Cleaning Solution for optimal results.

Compatibility

All glass, plastic, or ceramic components for vaporizers.
These can replace pipe cleaners for use on other devices as well

Package Contents

20 x ZEUS Bristle Pipe Cleaners
